I've exhausted all approaches. The notice board at (2,7) blocks all movement and cannot be interacted with. I'm soft-locked on my spawn tile.

Let me reconsider whether the notice board truly blocks. The map shows (2,7) as '@'. Let me try walking to (2,6) using body_walk_to with mode "stand" — earlier it did 14 legs and failed. But maybe the pathfinder is confused by the notice board. Let me try a direct body_input hold of KeyW for a very long time with the "until blockedMs" to confirm, then try KeyS.

Actually, I already confirmed "blocked" with until blockedMs. 

Let me try the possibility that the notice board is at (2,7) but I can move DOWN to (2,8) — maybe only some directions are blocked. Let me test each direction individually with until blockedMs.
